Candidate: `JiHost` publicly exposes the HCP listener through `hcpPort()`, but Spring configuration cannot select that port. `JiHostProperties` defines only the REST `port`, and auto-configuration forwards only `JI_HOST_PORT`; the underlying host independently consumes `JI_HOST_HCP_PORT`. Consequently, Spring deployments cannot configure the advertised HCP endpoint and are forced onto an ephemeral port.
